links.outcome: Expert-rated quality of structured CXR report outputs, protocol-grounded agent versus LLM-only baselines
links.effect: Expert radiologists and clinicians rated outputs 4.52 out of 5 on average; concept categorization F1 was 0.96; reported as surpassing LLM-only foundation-model baselines.
links.quote: Notably, expert radiologists and clinicians rated the final structured outputs with an average score of 4.52 out of 5, indicating a level of reliability that surpasses baseline approaches relying solely on LLM-based foundation models.

unlisted_practices: Decomposing report structuring into a Plan-Act-Observe agent loop with specialized tools guided by clinical protocols (ABCDEF for CXR)

screen.reason: The paper introduces MedPAO, a protocol-driven agentic framework for structuring medical reports, and evaluates its performance against baseline LLMs using clinician/radiologist ratings and benchmark metrics.
